## WIRE_ERROR_DETAILS_SCHEMAS variable

The details schema for every code a service may send.

**Signature:**

```typescript
WIRE_ERROR_DETAILS_SCHEMAS: {
    readonly [C in WireErrorCode]: z.ZodType<ErrorDetailsByCode[C]>;
}
```

## Remarks

Known fields are validated strictly (enums exactly as in [ErrorDetailsByCode](./contracts.errordetailsbycode.md)<!-- -->; optional fields may be absent but never `undefined`<!-- -->, matching the details types under `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`<!-- -->). Unknown extra keys are stripped rather than rejected: a newer service may add informational fields without breaking older clients, and stripping keeps unexpected data out of reconstructed errors. The mapped type requires an entry per wire code, so a new code without a schema is a compile error.
